name: draft pricing: shipped default is FLAT 0%
description: Proves the paid-draft rate is now 0% (flat 2,500 CR every buy) rather than +25% per buy. bob first asserts redis holds NO pricing override, so the test is measuring the shipped default and not a leftover from an earlier run. He funds carol; carol then buys twice and is billed exactly 2,500 each time with the button price never moving. Also checks the derived copy degrades sensibly at 0% ('same cost every buy', 'flat') instead of '+0%'.

steps._comment: HARD ASSERT: DBG is admin-only, so this also proves bob is still an admin.

steps.name: open admin as bob
steps.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=debug-input]'); if (!el) return 'ERR no input'; const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; if (el.value !== 'admin') { set.call(el, 'admin'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } el.focus(); el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', code: 'Enter', keyCode: 13, which: 13, bubbles: true })); return 'submitted'; })()

steps._comment: HARD ASSERT: pricing panel rendered (the loading branch has no inputs).
HARD ASSERT: stepPct is NOT overridden in redis. Without this the whole test could pass on a leftover override from an earlier run and prove nothing about the shipped default.
HARD ASSERT: firstCost not overridden either.
HARD ASSERT: at 0% the admin source line says 'flat', not the absurd 'then +0% per buy'.

steps.name: probe the live tier table
steps.expression: (() => { document.querySelectorAll('#fw-flat-probe').forEach(n => n.remove()); const t = [0,1,2,3,4].map(i => { const e = document.querySelector('[data-testid=dp-tier-' + i + ']'); if (!e) return NaN; const tok = e.innerText.trim().split(/\s+/).pop(); return parseInt(tok.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''), 10); }); const allFlat = t.every(v => v === 2500); const d = document.createElement('div'); d.id = 'fw-flat-probe'; d.setAttribute('data-flat', allFlat ? '1' : '0'); d.setAttribute('data-tiers', t.join(',')); d.style.display = 'none'; document.body.appendChild(d); return t.join(','); })()
steps._comment: The tier chip is '#1 2,500' - row label and price share one testid, so strip the label by taking the last token, not by removing all non-digits.
HARD ASSERT: all 5 preview tiers are 2,500 CR. This is the 0% ladder. If the default were still 25% this reads 2500,3125,3900,4875,6100 and data-flat is '0'.
Chip supplies the u/-prefixed name. admin.getUser resolves either form now, but the chip is the reliable path.
HARD ASSERT: carol's record is loaded. Set Credits computes a DELTA from the loaded record, so clicking before this appears writes the wrong amount.

steps.name: set credits field to 50000
steps.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=admin-credits-input]'); if (!el) return 'ERR no credits input'; const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; set.call(el, '50000'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return 'typed'; })()

steps.name: scroll [data-testid=admin-set-credits] into view
steps.expression: (() => { const e = document.querySelector("[data-testid=admin-set-credits]"); if (!e) return 'MISSING'; e.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); return 'scrolled'; })()
steps._comment: Runner clicks by coordinates without scrolling first, so a control below the admin panel fold gets an off-screen click and the step still reports OK. Scroll first.
Coach bubble swallows nav taps. Normal FTUE chrome, not a bug.
let draft.nextCost land - until it does the button reads just BUY A DRAFT with no price
HARD ASSERT: the first buy costs the shipped 2,500 CR.
THE COPY ASSERT: at 0% the hub says 'same cost every buy'. If the derived string were still naive this reads 'cost +0% each buy'.

steps.name: carol hub BEFORE buy
steps.expression: (() => { const btn = document.querySelector('.dh-btn.credit'); const cost = parseInt((btn?.innerText || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''), 10); const stat = [...document.querySelectorAll('.dh-stat')].find(s => /CREDITS/.test(s.querySelector('.dh-stat-lbl')?.innerText || '')); const credits = parseInt((stat?.querySelector('.dh-stat-val')?.innerText || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''), 10); window.__f = { cost, credits, note: document.querySelector('.dh-credit-note')?.innerText.trim() }; return JSON.stringify(window.__f); })()

steps._comment: HARD ASSERT: carol was billed EXACTLY 2,500. This also proves the hub RE-RENDERED, which is what makes the next assert meaningful rather than a stale read.
THE CORE 0% ASSERT: after a buy the price is STILL 2,500 CR. Under the old +25% default this would read 3,125 CR.
HARD ASSERT: the SECOND buy also cost exactly 2,500.
HARD ASSERT: still 2,500 at tier 3. Two consecutive flat charges rule out an off-by-one in the tier index.
